restore_timing: Each trial builds its own backup from the same synthetic source; backup, restore with validation/checkpoints and their sum are measured separately.
invariance_check: Source and backup file membership/content hashes are checked outside timing; all metadata invariance is not claimed.
cache_control: not-controlled; no cache flush; alternate baseline/final order
limits: Synthetic profiles also include upstream JSONL/ZST, SQLite and target authentication fixtures.
Fixture generation and backup construction are outside restore timing.
Final restore timing includes durable plan and checkpoints.
IO ZIP strategies are not metadata-equivalent full restorations.
No duration guarantee and no extrapolation to a real backup.
